record_title: Critical algebraic decay and logarithmic correction at the Ricker flip threshold
provenance: Analytic global-iteration and local second-iterate asymptotics for the scalar Ricker map at the first period-doubling threshold.
limitations: Applies to the deterministic one-dimensional Ricker map exactly at r=2. No novelty is claimed for global attraction below the threshold or for generic parabolic-iteration methods. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; several older model-specific stability sources were not all inspected at full theorem level.
